A '''battle''' took place over the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. Launching the offensive as part of a plot to sway the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] into believing that the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] was their eventual target, the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] defeated Tynna's limited [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] defenses and released a [[Yuuzhan Vong chemical|chemical]] into the planet's waters to prepare them for the eventual production of matériel.

==Preparations==
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="EssReaComp" /> during the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Yuuzhan Vong [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] [[Malik Carr]] and [[Nas Choka]] made a deal with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] to collaborate on the furnishing of intelligence and logistical support. As such, Hutt [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealings were halted in [[Star system/Legends|systems]] soon to be targeted by the invaders; along with the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian]] and [[Bothawui system|Bothawui systems]], one such locale was the [[Tynnani system]]. However, the Yuuzhan Vong plan was a feint; while the New Republic rushed to defend [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], the New Republic [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|shipyards]] at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]&mdash;the Yuuzhan Vong's real goal&mdash;would be left relatively undefended.<ref name="Jedi Eclipse" />

==The battle==
Shortly after, the Yuuzhan Vong launched the attack on Tynna in an attempt to ensure that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] believed their captured intelligence. While an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] contingent of two hundred New Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] was posted over Tynna, it was quickly defeated by the invaders.<ref name="Jedi Eclipse" />

Having done away with its defenders, the Yuuzhan Vong made planetfall on Tynna and landed at the [[Tanallay Surge complex]].<ref name="Jedi Eclipse" /> Tricked by the collaborationist [[Peace Brigade]] into surrendering without mounting any resistance,<ref name="NJOSource">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> a group of several hundred unarmed [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnans]] awaited the Yuuzhan Vong at the Surge complex. However, commanders [[Nas Choka]] and [[Malik Carr]] instead oversaw the release of a [[Yuuzhan Vong chemical|chemical]] into the local [[Water/Legends|waters]] with a view to [[Terraforming/Legends|transforming]] Tynna into a biological production facility. Designed to augment the water for the production of [[dovin basal]]s and [[villip]]s, the chemical was deployed at a lagoon near the Surge complex and quickly spread across Tynna, turning the planet's blue seas yellow. The events were broadcast to every [[City/Legends|city]] on Tynna, and were also witnessed by New Republic intelligence officers [[Belindi Kalenda]] and [[Showolter]], who observed the conquest from a [[LightStealth-18 Reconnaissance Ship]] nearby.<ref name="Jedi Eclipse" />

==Aftermath==
Following the conquest, Carr and Choka reported on their gains to [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]], detailing Tynna's role in the Yuuzhan Vong's overall campaign. In addition to accomodating the growth of dovin basals capable of stripping the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] protecting the New Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Tynna would serve as a staging platform for further actions in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian]] and [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sectors]].<ref name="Jedi Eclipse" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Tynna first appeared in the novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]] and released in [[2000]].<ref name="Jedi Eclipse" />
